configs.name: layer-streaming-default
configs.notes: First request includes graph scan (~7 min for 8 tokens). Steady decode ~20-50 s/token.

configs.name: reference-qwen2.5-7b-full-gpu
configs.notes: Fits entirely in VRAM; use for speed comparisons.

tuning.OLLAMA_STREAMING_BUDGET_rationale: 6 GiB buffer on 12 GiB cards: leaves headroom for KV/graph while allowing more resident blocks than 4 GiB default.
tuning.do_not_use_layer_streaming_for: Models that fit fully in VRAM (e.g. qwen2.5:7b) — set OLLAMA_LAYER_STREAMING=0 for ~70+ eval TPS.
